app.title: Meal System
app.subtitle: Rice cooker + fresh vegetables + 10 minutes of prep
week.hint: Build every meal from dishes: either a recipe or a single product. Each dish can carry its own add-ons.
week.amountHint: Change the amount — nutrition and the shopping list follow.
shopping.title: Shopping Planner
shopping.empty: Fill in the week plan first — the ingredient list will be generated automatically.
shopping.hint: Ingredients are calculated from the week plan. Batch meals are counted by preparations, not servings. The approximate measure from the recipes comes first, grams and millilitres are in parentheses.
nutrition.sourceNote: Estimates from USDA FoodData Central (approximate; brands vary).
nutrition.recomputedNote: Recalculated from your products and edits; ingredients without a brand keep their USDA values.
recipes.count: {{count}} recipes. Search by name, filter by tags, or tap any for details.
recipes.noMatch: Nothing found. Reset the filters or change the query.
picker.noMatch: Nothing found. Reset the filters or change the query.
picker.filterMemoHint: The filter is remembered for this meal.
picker.addOnHint: Add-ons count towards the daily nutrition and the shopping list.
picker.tagModeHint: Mark what counts as breakfast, lunch, or dinner for you — these tags are visible only to you.
dishTags.title: My tags
dishTags.editHint: Tap a tag to rename it, or ✕ to remove it from every dish.
dishTags.confirmDelete: Remove the tag "{{name}}" from every dish?
tour.week.tabs.title: Four tabs
tour.week.tabs.body: "Week Plan" is what you eat, "Shopping" is what to buy for it (built for you), "Recipes" is the catalog with instructions.
tour.week.addDish.title: Build a meal
tour.week.addDish.body: Press "+ dish". A meal takes as many dishes as you need — porridge and an egg for breakfast, say.
tour.week.sourceRecipes.title: Recipes
tour.week.sourceRecipes.body: Full recipes with steps and nutrition. A recipe is added by the portion.
tour.week.sourceProducts.title: Products
tour.week.sourceProducts.body: The other half of the switch is single products: grains, cottage cheese or an egg can be a dish with no recipe at all. Have a look — the list is quite different from the recipes.
tour.week.search.title: Search by name
tour.week.search.body: When you know what you are after, two letters beat scrolling the list.
tour.week.tags.title: Tag filters
tour.week.tags.body: Tags come in groups: what's in it, what it is, cooking, accents. "More filters" opens the rest, and "reset" under the chips clears them all at once. The filter you pick is remembered for this meal.
tour.week.amount.title: Amount
tour.week.amount.body: Adjust the grams right here — the calories and an approximate measure like "≈ 2 tbsp" update beside it.
tour.week.pickDish.title: Pick a dish
tour.week.pickDish.body: Tap any row — the dish lands in your plan and we carry on.
tour.week.addOn.title: Add-ons
tour.week.addOn.body: "＋" attaches berries, honey, nuts or a sauce to this dish rather than to the whole meal. Its calories join the daily total, its ingredients the shopping list.
tour.week.pdf.title: The plan as a PDF
tour.week.pdf.body: The week and every recipe it uses, steps included, in one file — print it or open it on your phone at the stove. The button next to it does the opposite: it wipes the whole week.
tour.week.about.title: The full guide
tour.week.about.body: Everything you just saw, in detail: how dishes and add-ons work, where the nutrition comes from, how shopping measures are derived.
tour.shopping.pdf.title: The list to go
tour.shopping.pdf.body: The shopping list downloads as one PDF, grouped by the same categories. It opens on your phone right in the shop — no connection, no account. If you shop from the site instead, the ticks stay in this browser.
tour.recipes.filters.title: Search and tags
tour.recipes.filters.body: The same tag vocabulary as the week plan, plus any tags of your own.
tour.recipes.openCard.title: Open any recipe
tour.recipes.openCard.body: Inside are the ingredients, steps, tips and micronutrients. Tap a card to carry on.
tour.recipes.newTag.title: Your own tag
tour.recipes.newTag.body: The "My tags" section is yours to fill. Tap a tag to put it on this dish, or create a new one: meal times are absent from the catalog because everyone draws the line between lunch and dinner somewhere else.
tour.recipes.editTags.title: Rename and delete
tour.recipes.editTags.body: "Edit tags" turns the chips editable: a tap renames, ✕ removes the tag from every dish. The four suggested tags are ordinary ones too — rework them to fit your day.
tour.account.products.title: Your products
tour.account.products.body: Add the yogurt or bread you actually buy with the numbers off its label, and the nutrition is recalculated across every recipe at once, base ones included.
tour.account.toRecipes.title: The "Recipes" tab
tour.account.toRecipes.body: An account adds something to this tab. Head over — we will show you.
tour.account.ownRecipe.title: Recipes of your own
tour.account.ownRecipe.body: Write your own recipe, or adjust and hide a shipped one. All of it is visible only to you, only in your account.
tour.account.backup.title: Backup
tour.account.backup.body: The same place exports all your data into one file and imports it back: the free tier has no automatic backups.
pdf.title: Week Plan
auth.intro: An account stores your own recipes and products. The base catalog works without signing in.
auth.resetSent: Reset link sent. Check your inbox, including the spam folder.
auth.privacyNote: Firebase stores your password as a hash: neither this app nor its database ever sees it. Your recipes and products are visible only to you.
auth.errorInvalidEmail: That email address is not valid.
auth.errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists.
auth.errorWeakPassword: Password is too short — use at least 6 characters.
auth.errorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Try again later.
auth.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
auth.errorUnauthorizedDomain: This domain is not allowed in the Firebase Auth settings.
auth.errorOperationNotAllowed: Email and password sign-in is not enabled in the Firebase console.
auth.errorGeneric: That did not work. Please try again.
account.title: Account
account.backupNote: The free tier has no automatic backups. The export saves your recipes, products, settings, and week plan into a single JSON file.
account.confirmImport: Importing overwrites entries with matching ids. Continue?
account.errorFormat: This is not an export file from this app.
account.errorVersion: This file was created by a newer version of the app.
account.errorTooLarge: Too many entries for a single import.
products.intro: Add the brands you actually buy and the nutrition is recalculated from their labels — across every recipe at once, base ones included.
products.privacyNote: Products attach to an ingredient from the shared catalog and are visible only to you, so the shared ingredient list never grows.
products.empty: No products yet. Add your yogurt or bread and the numbers become yours.
products.formIntro: Copy the values from the label. Fields you leave empty keep their USDA values.
products.ingredientHint: You cannot create a new ingredient, only your own variant of an existing one. That is what keeps the shopping list and unit conversion working.
products.name: Name
products.per100gHint: Fill in whatever the package lists. The rest comes from USDA so vitamins and minerals are not zeroed out.
products.errorNoIngredient: Pick an ingredient from the catalog.
products.errorNoNutrition: Fill in at least one value per 100 g.
editor.ownIntro: Your recipe. Visible only to you.
editor.baseIntro: Editing a base recipe. Changes are saved to your account only and do not affect anyone else.
editor.name: Name
editor.previewWarnings: Some ingredients were left out of the calculation:
editor.warning.unknownUnit: cannot convert this unit to grams
editor.tagsHint: Tags are only there for searching. The meal is chosen in the plan, not by a recipe tag.
editor.languageNote: Text is saved for the current interface language ({{lang}}). To provide it in the other language, switch languages and edit the recipe again.
editor.confirmDelete: Remove this recipe from your list?
editor.confirmRevert: Discard your edits and restore the original recipe?
editor.errorNoIngredients: Add at least one ingredient with an amount.
